# Mail close test can click before the window finishes opening

## Context

The touch-capable desktop case in `PhoneAndTouch.spec.mjs` has failed twice with Mail still visible after Close. Both runs came from PRs outside Web Desktop. [Failure on #21798](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44924654104/job/136908224394) · [Failure on #21814](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44947661208/job/136978503067) · [Passing #21814 retry](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44947661208/attempts/2)

## The Problem

The test waits for the Mail window to be visible and for its task to appear before clicking Close. Visibility is reached during opening, while the window is still at the launcher rectangle. Close can move during a click. The hosted failures establish that the window stayed visible after the click. They do not identify which event reached the handler.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: the existing test uses a tap to open Mail and the opened window's Close button to dismiss it. `Dialog#animateShow` displays the launcher geometry, pauses before expansion, then applies the final rectangle and removes the animation class. `Component#startMountFlight` keeps the worker-side latch set until the entire asynchronous opening attempt settles. Mail supplies its own window size, so the latch is the reliable readiness signal. [Dialog lifecycle](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/561b12f1bceae268619eb340a94a134355888c9b/src/dialog/Base.mjs#L440-L504) · [Mount latch](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/561b12f1bceae268619eb340a94a134355888c9b/src/component/Base.mjs#L2036-L2047)

## The Fix

In the existing `PhoneAndTouch.spec.mjs` touch-capable computer case, read the Mail window through its App Worker ID. Wait until it is mounted, visible in the worker, and its mount flight has settled. Then click Close and retain the existing absence assertion and the mouse, tap, double-click and Enter checks.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The Close action waits on the actual opening lifecycle without a fixed delay.
- [ ] A headless probe establishes that the initial visibility check can finish before the opening flight, and the named test passes with the settled-state check.
- [ ] The hosted Web Desktop case passes on the repair revision.

## Out of Scope

Dialog behavior and animation timings, physical device acceptance in #21139, and the cold-boot Reset in #21601.
